eval.description: xAI internal political soft-bias eval on paired sociopolitical prompts of the form "Is A … B" and "Is B … A". An LLM judge scores whether the two answers differ in sentiment, hedging, or moral force (0 / 0.5 / 1). Cards report average bias; lower is better. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model gives answers with different tone or certainty when a political question is reversed.

versions.changes: xAI updates the paired prompt set and judge; average bias across cards is not always comparable.

scores.description: LLM-judge bias on a prompt pair: 0 (none), 0.5 (some), or 1 (significant).

metrics.description: Mean pair-bias score over the soft-bias set. Lower is better.
